result:
I played all 24 months. **Net cost was $1,072.8M**: all three training runs were met on time, no inference demand went unserved, and there were no penalties.

| Item | $M |
|---|---|
| GPU purchases (54k gen H in total) | 1,000.0 |
| Power | 217.4 |
| Cloud reservations | 63.3 |
| Spot | 62.4 |
| Resale income | −21.2 |
| **Total spent** | 1,321.9 |
| Minus GPUs still owned, marked at month-24 value | −353.3 |
| Plus remaining contract and power obligations | +104.3 |
| **Net cost** | **1,072.8** |

**How it went:**
- **Buying:** I ordered 15k gen H GPUs in month 0, 10k in month 2 and 15k in month 6. Supply stayed loose, so orders shipped quickly. I bought rather than leaning on cloud because I put the chance of tight supply by months 16–23 at roughly 45%. A shortfall then would have cost at least $200M, which outweighed the extra cost of owning the GPUs.
- **Gen N launch:** the "around month X" rumours narrowed to month 18 by month 8, which the vendor confirmed in month 17. That ruled out buying gen N: it would have arrived too late to be worth it.
- **Months 16–23:** I covered the gap with a 6 kH, 6-month reservation from month 16 and 10 kH of spot from month 17. Spot was cheap ($0.72–0.93M per kH-month) after the launch price cut. The run finished on 320 kH-months or more with a small margin.

**Where money was wasted:**
- **Too much training too early:** months 0–7 got 135 of 60 kH-months and months 8–15 got 239 of 140. The second gen H order came too early, and the power I signed in month 6 started early. Both added capacity in months 8–15 that wasn't needed.
- **Spot in month 15:** I set it before checking that the months 8–15 run was already complete, so about $5M of spot went unused.
- **Power energised early:** the 16 MW I signed in month 12 started in month 15 rather than month 20, giving five months of paid power that wasn't needed.
